reviews.text: Classic. Classic Deck, Been around for years , Thank you
Wow. So many interesting cards in one deck

Beautiful but mostly negative cards. I love the artwork and theme of this deck. My only issue is that it seems heavily weighted with negative cards. There doesn’t seem to be many positive outcomes, even while trying to interpret the positive- this deck seems to make that difficult.

Convenient. I love that I have this anywhere I go and it’s discreet so I don’t have to worry that anyone will know what I’m doing (if wanting to maintain privacy). 
I usually use this first thing in the morning to get a sense of what my day will be like and will use it randomly for other questions throughout the day/week. 
I’ve had this app for years and have never had any technical issues, I can easily share readings with friends & family, and of course I love the artwork! 
Thank you for this app!
Best app I’ve ever paid for.. This is by far my favorite deck, and I end up using this app more than the actual cards themselves.
Lovely deck and the app is easy to use. No matter what the reading this deck feels compassionate and warm

Love this app. I love the beautiful artwork and while I’m not a big believer in anything spiritual or supernatural, I think it’s fun and beneficial to pull a card and think about the questions and suggestions.
Love the images! Awesome readings.. I love this app. The artwork is stirring & beautiful. The readings are eerily on point. All around goodness.

Beyond beautiful, meditative text. This deck is one of the most detail-filled that I have seen, and the images are gorgeous. The text that accompanies each always leaves me with something new to contemplate throughout the day, much like you might meditate on a question and then find your mind drifting back to that question as you eat lunch or drive home.
Nature’s Deck for Witches. A great deck for Green Witches and Wizards alike.

Love the depth of this deck. Being mostly familiar with Oracle decks, I consider myself a beginner in the art of Tarot. I love the shamanic theme of this deck, it’s depth, detailed book, and the questions it suggests the reader contemplate. It is by far, one of the most comprehensive apps I’ve ever used.

I also like having the choice of background cloth and the shuffling and deck cutting options. I like shuffling, as it helps me to focus more on my question, and settle in to the reading. Thanks to the designers of this app🙏🏻💖. Great job!!!!

Love this deck and app!. I got the deck first and read the wonderful book cover to cover. There is a lot in it so I’ll definitely have to go back and read it again. But the app has everything too. Explains each deck. Teaches you each layout and how to read in in order. It’s very fantasy for a beginner. I haven’t done many pulls. Maybe 10. But every time I use my deck I fall more in love with it! I connected with my dad through a spiritual medium and she gave me a couple of things to look for in my first deck. I searched and searched stores and online and finally found this deck! So in love!

Love the deck, the app stays out of the way. This deck speaks to me very clearly. I’m not sure why, but it’s unmistakable. I used the physical deck for a while, but the app is just as good and much more convenient. Without the app, I’m sure I would have lost track of the deck by now, even though the experience of using it is uncanny. The app presents just enough of the experience of the cards and their explanations to work without getting in the way or being overly wordy and intrusive. I have it set so it doesn’t simulate the shuffling, cutting, drawing individual cards, etc., which I honestly don’t need. (They’re just bits, not real cards, right?) Even so, when I scan the layout of cards at the beginning of a reading, I have to chuckle at how obvious the story is and how closely it seems to fit my questions. Stepping through each card and its reading points, I find bits of meaning that I wouldn’t have noticed or seen by only looking at the card. After using the app for years, I’ve only recently begun using the journal feature, but it does seem helpful. The process of writing my interpretation down helps clarify the thoughts. To be clear, it’s the deck and it’s imagery and reading points that are meaningful to me. The app is just a way to use the deck. So, if the deck doesn’t speak to you, find a different one. There are many available.

Insightful, Fun, Reliable. This deck has become a big part of my practice. It helps one really listen to the deeper archetypes in nature and to walk with this gnosis. I love that i can shuffle, cut the deck or have an ‘instant’ reading by spending on the mood. Beautiful deck and reliable technology.

Love this product and the deck for which it stands. My life has been up and down and I lost the book that accompanied my deck. I found the app by mistake. I have become accustomed to pulling cards and reading the text for friends over coffee. I was shocked to find the new update added new readings for the “draw a card” segment. I love how I don’t have to through the book to find the place on the wheel, (that was not included In the text below draw a card.) even though I didn’t mind it, but I miss the meaning, reading points and the languid description of the cards, my friends really enjoyed how I read them.

Beautiful, wise, and well made.... The Wildwood Tarot is a truly beautiful and wise teacher for the attentive soul attuned to the Old Ways of Faerie and the Greenwood. Not fantasy versions of these, but the genuine old ways of the ancient forest of the inner and outer worlds.

This app, created by Fool’s Dog, brings out this beauty and wisdom in an easy-to-work-with practical way. Mark Ryan, one of the creators of the deck, has voiced the vocal prompts here, and they feel perfect for this.

One more thing... It’s self-contained, and works without internet... useful when the cell towers are further away, or for whatever reason I’m in ‘airplane mode’.

Much appreciation to Mark, John, Will, the Fool’s Dog folk, and the innerworld contacts who inspired this...

Buy for the text. The artwork did not draw me in, the way some decks do, but the written content is next level. I love the reinterpretation of some of the cards, and the lengthy philosophical & psychological explanations. I’ve been reading tarot for 14yrs, and this deck brings something new to my knowledge.

Loving this app!. This is new deck for me and is a whole new system in itself. I think this app will really help me to learn the Wildwood deck quickly. I love having the book portion of the deck available to me as well thru the app. I’ve been reading via Kindle for a little while now vs a printed book and I love the easy access of information without having another thing to carry around or keep up with. I am completely satisfied with my purchase. Blessings and thank you!
Love this app. I love this app. I can practice the cards with the card a day feature and learn the meanings. Great app I use every day.

One complaint. I love the app and the cards, but I would love if you would make it easier to save readings for future reference. Sometimes my readings will save automatically, sometimes I spend half an hour trying to figure out how (I am not computer illiterate). This is extremely frustrating to me as I have lost the results of so many readings.

So informative, I refer to it as Technancy. I am the founder and former Chief of Ravynshire Druid Grove, a Grove which now belongs to the druids and pagans of the Loyal Arthurian Warband under King Arthur Pendragon. 

I am very particular where druid education is concerned, to such a degree that the students of the Stateside Warband (we aren’t scary... always) are also very particular about what they accept for themselves through academic. 

Though, the significance of some kind of magic imbues this deck - even before phone apps and still
now I turn to the paper deck because of its profound correlation and ability to correlate, to the daily lives of the reader or querent. 

I even teach class concerning technomancy with this deck’s app at the centre of my point. /|\

Unexpected pleasure. This app is the best Tarot deck and book I’ve ever had, out of dozens. I had always passed it by till I saw the app. (Convenience.). With the app comes quite a long “book.” The nature themes resonate. The card meanings: so wise and acceptable and healing. Better than what my intuition has been able to muster. Humbling. You really get your money’s worth compared to other oracle/Tarot apps, as delightful as they might be. Grateful.

One improvement. I love the cards! But I can only see all the Major Arcana cards outside of a reading. Can you also index the minor arcana cards so we can peruse them?
Thanks!
Wildwood Tarot. Beautiful images and iconography and an app that does so many things!
Great deck. These cards are beautiful and make me feel at peace. The app is simple to use. I especially love that I can build my own spread. Thanks!

Lost the book years ago, but this is better!. I love doing readings outside the app and then uploading that external reading. It makes it so easy to pull up the meanings of the cards one by one, all while enlarging the gorgeous artwork, and the option to save and journal the reading is right at your fingertips. 

I lost the book that went with this deck years ago but this is so much more efficient. I wish it had more info on how to read the spreads, but I’ve managed with my memory and experience of how they were described in the original book!
Can’t log your own card readings?. Can you please make a way so that you can log your readings from your own cards? I would love this if you could.
Everyday Deck. This is my everyday digital deck.

Love Wildwood Tarot. I have this deck. Love using both my physical set & this version. I especially love the card of the day. It generally always makes sense to those attuned to this beautiful version. 💖💛💜💙💚

Journal crashes. I love this deck and the journal feature, but I am unable to review my previous journal entries. Every time I try to launch the journal the app crashes and has to be relaunched. I have one other deck app from this developer that works great. The problem seems to be this app and my phone iPhone running 11.2.5. I hope it’s fixed and my journal entries are still intact.
Noble natural wisdom of our ancestors who love us like the root lives the acorn.. Noble natural wisdom of our ancestors who love us like the root lives the acorn.
A beautiful deck. A fantastic deck for those who love the influence of nature in their readings

Useful companion. I own the actual cards and book, and just use this when on the go to review my cards and such. The daily card and such are nice, but the lack human element loses what I feel could be a true meaningful reading. Hence this app serves best as a companion in my opinion. I would recommend this to anyone who is an active reader using these cards.

Oracle extraordinaire. The wisdom of the spreads - and the art - is empowering. shamanic and useful.
Only drawback is that it doesn't explain reversed cards - which are pulled about half the time

Love This Deck/Application!. I have used the Rider Waite deck and derivations of it for many years but I was excited to see this new deck from John Matthews and company with great illustrations from Will Worthington. After working with this application for some time, I have found that these cards really speak to me and that, despite some reservations, the application is an uncannily accurate form of divination.
Excellent Deck!. Highly recommend this tarot deck. Very interesting and interesting!

Informative App but Needs Explanations for Reversed Cards. I used this app in one of my first explorations of Tarot, and I learned a lot about the basics from this app. There is a lot of useful information about various cards and spreads. Also, the illustrations on the cards and accompanying explanations are quite lovely. The main problem I had with this app is the fact that almost all of the cards I drew seemed to be reversed. This situation would be fine (maybe my energy really is that blocked), but there is no description of what the reversed cards mean in the context of this deck. Since I am fairly new to Tarot, I was constantly cross-referencing information on other websites and trying to apply it to my readings, but it just became awkward and tiring. I felt like relying on other interpretations meant I lost the Celtic/ecological nuances in this deck. To solve the problem, I now treat this deck as a sort of oracle deck, only read the cards in an upright position (which is an option in the settings menu), and use another deck for more "general" Tarot purposes.
Beautiful deck. This is a beautiful deck with meaningful interpretations.
Beautifully rendered, insightfully written!. Beautifully rendered, insightfully written!
So impressed!. The deck and the app are both fantastic. I love working with this deck- even more so than my physical ones!!

It Doesn't Get Better!. Clear, easy to understand, easy to use, app has worked without malfunctions. The deck is beautiful to the eye. The verbiage is empowering, uplifting, challenging. 
 There is absolutely nothing else I need from either a Tarot deck or an app that this does not have. A comprehensive and delightful experience!
LOVE IT😍😍😍. Yu won't regret this purchase 😘

Great deck, great app!. The Wildwood Tarot is as stunning digitally as it it is in your hands. This review is about the application by Fool's Dog. It is a great app to use. I would like to see some changes: a) the ability to highlight, copy and paste text into user meanings/journal entries, b) the Tarot spread descriptions are buried in the "about the app" section not listed in the "choose a spread" section, c) user card meanings should be accessible from more places than just the main menu, IMO.

Love it!!. I just bought the actual cards and book yesterday. I have never been drawn to tarot before discovering this deck. When I found the app today, I had to buy it. I'm very impressed with the clarity and organization of the cards in this app, as well as having the option to read the full description as written in the book. I like that I can study the cards on the go, which is my purpose for purchasing this app. And all for only $3.99?!

Thrilled!. I have the Wildwood deck and was thrilled to find an ap for it. I love the variety of spreads in the ap and the intuitive interface. It's such an insightful and uplifting deck, so I'm really happy to always have it with me now!

Beautiful App!. Lots of features and beautiful artwork. I have the physical deck, but love this app for it's ease of use. A lot of time has been put into the development of the app. Really nicely done.
Simply beautiful. Stunning artwork and easy to use app, I'm new to the tarot world and am so thankful I decided to purchase the wildwood app! Simply lovely

I truly love it. I have the actual deck but I use this app on the go. I love using the daily card feature and also drawing cards in particular situations. I am a big fan of the artwork, interpretations and the overall archetypes/themes of this tarot system. It takes awhile to learn, especially if you're used to another deck, but I find it a more holistic and nourishing system than classic tarot.
👍🏻. This app is definitely better then expected. Everything you could want in an electronic tarot deck

I love this deck. The placement definitions at the top along with multiple meanings for the royalty cards is very helpful. I also enjoy the untraditional meanings. They add to my interpretation of other decks.
An exquisite and incredibly insightful oracle. I've practiced tarot for over 20 years and this is one of the beautiful and wonderfully well-written decks I've ever used - deeply resonates!

Gorgeous & detailed. I have several physical decks but it's nice to have this one on my phone at all times. The imagery is beautiful and the card descriptions are very detailed. I think it'll be worth buying the physical deck as well.
Awesome. This is my second tarot deck and I love it!
Awesome. Just love this. I own the deck, but this app makes it great on the fly.
Great app. Very easy to use with lots of features.
Magnificent, Realllly Guwd. 5 stars, excellent app. I ask it the app for advice as if it was a wise old wizard, and it always gives me perfect responses
Oneuniverse. This is the best tarot app, I've ever used.
Beautiful. I've been using a tarot deck since the 90s created by this couple and it was always my favorite, until now. Seamless, beautiful and bug free.

Love this deck and app!. I stumbled upon this deck via another app and was drawn to it immediately. So I bought the cards, this app and the book. The coolest thing is that this app is the complete book. So using the actually deck and reading from the app has made learning the deck SO easy. I'm sure it's just a good fit for me-it speaks to me so that helps. But the funny thing is I tend to draw the identical cards, from the deck and in the app on the same days. Very cool.
Beautiful Art!. Love this deck!
So lovely!. Life changing insight and beauty.

Superb imagery and deep reading. There is artistry, rich symbolism, and intention in this collection. I appreciate this deck through and through. The meanings are well written and leaves me with just enough to get into my own meaning-making process without feeling like I am getting something handed to me.
Stunning artwork and profound insight. Very pleased with this app. The artwork is absolutely gorgeous. It's very easy to use and very insightful. Highly recommended.
Fantastic App. Any seeker who identifies with the Northern European pagan traditions should take a look. Nice flow of archetypes. Solid tarot deck.
Shuffle. An amazing deck and a good app. I would like a feature to be able to shake the phone, and have another random single card displayed.
Kill's Time. More used to the traditional Tarot drawings but this deck is okay. There are many other themed decks to choose from so choose wisely grasshopper.
Helps you look at all sides of a dilemma.. Use it regularly. Fantastic artwork. Great symbology. Best way to look at a situation in multiple ways. Journal feature rocks!!
Great app!. Reads just like a real deck. Beautiful imagery. App functions well.
Fantastic. The art is amazing and the inspiration and dedication each card offers is insightful.
In California. It's positively eerie how spot on these cards are. Love them. Highly recommend them.
So great. Love this app! The design, the artwork, the descriptions are all amazing. Plus it saves your reads and allows you to make notes in a journal. Top notch.

I attune beautifully. Perfect - 

I own the physical deck and it writes like I think, which I find very rare. Am so pleased to find the app available, and the first readings I did we're incredibly apropos and aligned with my current situation perfectly.

Not a true tarot deck. Should not be marketed/ categorized under "tarot" or should be labeled as "based on tarot". This deck does not align well with traditional tarot decks so cross referencing is not possible. It can be used as a divinatory or meditative tool, but from what I can tell, won't equate to traditional tarot cards. Meanings seem different. If you are used to a traditional deck and are looking for an electronic equivalent for a mobile device, download their traditional fools dog deck. Otherwise, the pictures are pretty. You can use an addition to or adjunct to your usual tarot readings.
Wildwood tarot. I love this app! Helps to explain a lot of what's on my mind, and in my heart

Tarotl on the wild side..... This app is based on a very solid Tarot deck. There are some variations on the traditional deck which match the wild, outdoorsy theme. 

The app works quite well. It offers the user several options for both quick, single card reads and more extensive spreads. The graphics are crisp. The interpretations are brief but not bad for a phone app.
Love. I really enjoy this deck and many other Fool's Dog apps. It is really nice to use on iPad where you can enlarge and really see details of each card.

Real deal!. This is the only tarot card app I need. Ive checked out others 
This one is my favorite

Great Tarot app!. Nice layouts, artwork and descriptions... need I say more :/)

I like it!
Very useful. I have the wildwood deck and use it regularly. It's lovely to have it in my pocket all the time when I'm away from home. The app is stable and well-organized.
Wildwood. This is such a great app!!

My favorite Tarot. and the one I most relate to. I truly appreciate being able to read without the need to constantly have to translate from Abrahamic assumptions. 
Thank-you.
Lovely imagery. Very evocative.
Great tool for guidance. I have used this application, and I really think it has provided good visual guidance. Of course you need to be open and believe.
Great ap. Fun and super easy to use- it isn't a real deck but it is very close. Wish there was interpretations for reversals but that's my only complaint
My favorite. This app is, by far, my favorite tarot app. I have been using it for over a year. I find it to be amazingly accurate.

More Than App, More than Deck, It's an Ancient Culture Reborn!. I got the Wildwood Tarot deck when it first came out a few years ago and was blown away by the imagery and it's ancient voice. So much so, that when this app first appeared I just immediately bought it. The app, too, blew me away! It has everything a person needs to learn its ways. It truly is a complete equivalent to the physical book and deck set, just more portable! The essence of the physical deck has been brilliantly captured in this app! I've tried a lot of Tarot apps and this is, by far, the very best that can be had. It's well organized, easy to use and has been completely trouble free. I highly recommend it to anyone who is a fan of the physical deck or interested in learning a new, shamanic-based Tarot. You won't be disappointed!
🎇. Wild & wooly wondrous.

Disappointed. First, I have 2 other Fools Dog tarot apps, and their products are wonderful. But I don't respond well to this interpretation of tarot. They're more like oracle cards as the Minors have words associated with them that negates personal interpretation, which the authors actually champion. The animals court cards don't jive with the symbolic interpretations of their suits. And the voice!? It's creepy. The artwork however is lovely. Ultimately this deck/app is not for me, wish I could return them.
Love this!. Easy to understand and read me like an open book!
Fantastic App!. The cards are beautifully illustrated, and The readings are very illuminating. One of my favorite decks so far, there is a real sense of purpose and wisdom with these cards!
Thank you. Really helps me to focus. I'm very thankful.
Excellent app. This is a wonderful app. Full of beautiful art work. I love the explore option, as well as the journal entry option. Great job.
Well-designed. I really like how this app was planned. Lots of good features.
Friend. Excellent. Enjoying this app very much.

Great deck, great app. This deck is amazing! But for someone with small hands like me, it was tough to use the actual deck. This app lets me utilize the deck in a really user-friendly way. Plus I always have my cards with me! I love it!
Beautiful and anazing. I own the app and cards/book. The gorgeous art and writings resonant with me. I use this deck everyday. It can be quite uncanny in its accuracy. I LOVE this tarot version.
Nice Deck. I am really enjoying this deck. I like the journal part, because I can save a weekly or daily draw and review it to see if I can get more insight. This deck really speaks to me.

My go-to tarot app. This is by far my favorite tarot app of any I've tried. I use it almost every day. The descriptions are useful and applicable to a wide variety of subjects and the archetypes are for the most part positive. Some of the cards do not line up with the Universal Rider-Waite system so some adjustment may be necessary. For the most part I really connect with these cards and feel that they speak to me in my life. Definitely recommend.

Convenience at my fingertips. I absolutely love this app! Now I can not only study the tarot deck, I can do readings everywhere I go! Brilliant :)))
Thank you Wildwood Tarot team :)))
Liz Burns
Awesome. I use as a companion app for my physical deck. Today's card is great.
Great app. Perfect app for quick and logged readings.
Spot on. I Love this app. It's always spot on.

Magical. It's so important to find the right deck and I've found mine. The app works great but more than that I can feel the strong spiritual intention behind this system that is making my readings incredibly clear and useful.
Fresh Approach. Unusual insight, layered information this deck is a welcome expansion on an old wisdom. Love it!
Beautiful Content. Very impressed. Great way to explore the different tarot decks out there.
Cool. The design r amazing but interpretation is a little confusing.

You have found your deck. ...At least if the images of the deck on the previous page resonates with you. AND if you have, since childhood, always been into movies with universal messages/lessons which come from any ancient tribal group through out time. Yes, you know who you are. 

I never write reviews, but this app, the artwork on the cards, the descriptions, and the inner workings of the app/tarot itself have inspired me to this one time. I also purchased the same app makers other tarot deck apps, and have been enjoying bouncing back and forth between them with the same question for different perspective. 

However- this is by far my favorite, and my "go-to". Well worth the purchase!
The best!!!!. I have the actual deck and this app is equivalent in potency and Magick!!! Thank you ^.^
My favorite ipad deck.. I have about five decks now on my ipad and this is my favorite. Beautiful artwork and valuable card meanings make this my favorite.
Outstanding. Great deck. Accurate. Beautiful with great interpretations. All of these decks are so well put together. Recommended.
Beautiful deck. I really enjoy using this beautiful deck and helpful app.
Wildwood tarot. I love- it continue the great work! Will use- it everyday. Thank you..
Wildwood Tarot. Simply a magical and amazing deck. Great interactive experience. Clealy made with love!

FANTASTIC!!. This is a great tarot app! I love how earthy and simple it is. It gets you right back to basics, in terms of what a person's real instincts and motives are. The primal intuition that is at the heart of tarot.

Not your ordinary tarot deck. Easy to use! Use it at least once a day. Love the artwork. The journal makes it easy to see trends & parallels. Many options for types of tarot spreads. Especially like having the book text in the app for more in depth explanations & reference.
Great Application. Very nice, I use this app 3 times a day, very intuitive, great for on the go guidance.
Love it!. Amazing! Very accurate!

Easy to use, useful, beautiful. The cards are beautiful. Using the Tarot is easy and the system is intuitively constructed. The journal is simple to use. Going from one part of the program to another is easy. It has a daily draw to focus on. I really love this!

A very shamanic deck. I love this deck! Terrific concept, great expansion on traditional card depictions and interpretations, gorgeous art...
Portraying all the court cards as animals is a twist, but just one of many that makes this an especially potent deck to work with shamanically, i. e. draw a card, then journey into it. 
I have the physical deck and book, too, but this is more portable and really shows off the details in the artwork. 
My current favorite deck!

Well thought out. This is beautiful. I love this deck. Having used and seen others use this deck many times makes finding it on the App Store a joy. Using the app blew me away, journaling, formats, etc. make this well worth enjoying. Thanks.
Beautiful!. Excellent deck and app!

Love this. When I not able to access the book or deck this is perfect 
I love it

Incredibly accurate. Incredible how accurate this is considering it's electronic. I'd have to say there is indeed a personal "link" to the user. Spot on EVERY time, and every day for my life situations. 
I highly recommend this app.

Great deck. Great deck, beautiful art, easy to use app with many card layouts available, easy to use journal tool to record readings and comments and love that the full card descriptions from the book are available.

Beautiful graphics with well crafted messages. I love this app and also own the actual deck of cards (which I've been using for a long time). These are beautiful cards and the messages are well written. One of my all time favorites. And they always seem spot on.
Love. Love using this, I have this and a few other decks, not only is it great for reference but also a very useful tool if you're looking for guidance on the go. Definitely would recommend.

As Good as the Real Thing. I've had this app for almost a year now, and I must say, I'm very impressed. As is often the case while doing a real spread, the reading doesn't always make sense at first. But it never fails to make sense eventually, which is why I love the Journal aspect of this app. It logs every reading you do. Today, I reviewed some readings I did when I first installed the app, and it was totally on the money about everything I've experienced in the time since. I'm often skeptical that virtual tarot is as effective as the real thing, but I've definitely been proven otherwise. Not to mention, the images on the cards are absolutely beautiful, and the messages are grounding and make you feel like you've been transported to an ancient forest full of amazing wisdom. :)
Love it!. Wish I could order actual deck straight from app

The best. The Wildwood Tarot is the best tarot app in my opinion. The cards are beautiful, the descriptions are thorough yet still leave room for interpretation. This app also allows you to turn off reversals, which is great!
Superb!. I enjoy using this app daily. The content is insightful and the artwork is inspiring.
Almost five star.. It would have gotten five stars, but I also have Druid Oracles, by the same folks, and that deck set a higher level for oracle apps. Love both and use them daily.
Great and easy to use tarot. It is amazingly true and easy to interpret
Love it. I was skeptical, but I love how it works.
My new favorite deck. The art is beautiful. The app is perfectly user friendly. I love this interpretation of the tarot. Well done!
Excellent. One of the best tarot decks I've seen thus far! Great app, I recommend anything The Fool's Dog LLC is a part of in the realm of digital tarot.

In Love. Eery how accurate and on point these cards are, and how they help lead me to a more open minded journey on my spiritual path. I loaded up my phone with tarot card apps-- this was by far the best. I really resonate with the artwork--the many details that help give you clues aswell as the words. The journal and share pieces are easy to use. I love that you can pick a from a ton of different spreads--although I find myself using the "Draw One Card" the most often. Bravo to the creators of the app! It's really helped me to look at my problems and concerns from different perspectives.
Great App. Great App ... A little too esoteric for a beginner though ...
Love this!!!. Awesome app and gives you great insight. I personally enjoy the freewill, destiny and fate reading as well as the bow and arrow.
Fantastic !!!. Quite simply, a great, great tarot card app. Beautiful artwork too. Stunning.

Get this NOW!. This is a delicious and wonderful deck to work with. The app itself works very well for me. I enjoy the artwork, which is rich and lush. The descriptions are useful, yet not limiting to ones own spiritual imprint for both personal meditation and divination. I like this deck very much and highly recommend it, as with all the offerings through Fool's Dog. Try it....you will not be disappointed!!!
#1. Perfect.

Enjoyable, useful, & insightful. There is so much to this app. The art is wonderful, and the descriptions are nicely summarized, but offers detailed information as well. The journal entry is also a bonus. Something you don't get with other oracle deck apps. I've enjoyed using because it gives one much to ponder and bring about ones own wisdom.
A very good app. Makes it easy and a pleasure to work with a beautiful deck.

Tarot worth paying for!. The artwork is beautiful and the readings are thorough, insightful and supportive whether with a simple daily card or a multi card reading. A great new virtual companion to my days. Happy to have purchased this app!
Well Done!. I love this app! The artwork is gorgeous. The card meanings are drenched in myth and folklore. Navigation is super user friendly. Perfect for daily divination!
Excellent!. Love this deck!!
Amazingly accurate!. Fantastic app! Highly recommend.

Blessings 2 U. This deck Spoke to me!!

I actually just purchased this deck on Ebay..

This app. Is great, just feels so good communicating w/ nature..

Blessings to you

Lovely whether you're a pro or beginner!. Very well designed and descriptive! I've been a tarot reader for more than five years and find these readings just as powerful as a tactile deck. For experts and novices alike--easy to find descriptions when you'd like them and easy to ignore if you'd rather intuit. There's even an option to design your own spreads and pick single cards at random! As flexible as the real thing...

The Wildwood. I own the actual deck, and this app is a good study guide for learning the cards. The card a day also helps you learn a new card every day. Wonderful app. This is how all Tarot/Oracle apps should work. Big pluses for me are the Journal function that stores my readings and, better than that allows me to add my own comments. The fact that I can add my own cloth images that I can lay the cards on. Finally, and best of all (for me), that I can add my own meanings to the cards. This allows me to fully personalise the deck. The flexibility is also built in to only display my own meanings or to view them as an appendum to the deck creators interpretation. 

The cards are so lovely and packed with resonance for me. This is a pagan pre-Celtic deck where it's only real connection with standard Tarot deck comes from the structure of the deck, otherwise it goes off on its own tangent creating an entire self contained world. If fact it comes across more like an oracle deck which is lovely. Standard Tarots can feel rather serious and not a little heavy and scary. Not that this deck is fluffy, far from it.

I liked the app so much that I have just bought the real thing. I look forward to viewing them in conjunction with each other.

Tip:

One which makes this app truly great for me is the ability it gives me to copy interpretations from all over the net. You can then paste them with their links back into the personal readings section of the app. That way I am building up a brilliant multi-faceted interpretation section. I put my own comments inside square brackets so they stand out.
